_meta.description: VASP INCAR tags structured index, extracted from vasp.at/wiki

SYSTEM.brief: Name of the system (comment only, no effect on calculation)

ALGO.brief: Electronic minimization algorithm or GW calculation type
ALGO.notes: VeryFast does NOT support hybrid functionals. For hybrids use All or Damped. Fast is a robust default for DFT.

IALGO.notes: ALGO is the recommended interface. Only use IALGO for fine-grained control.

PREC.brief: Sets ENCUT, FFT grids, and other precision-related defaults
PREC.notes: Accurate avoids wrap-around errors. Use for volume relaxation (ISIF>=3).

ENCUT.notes: For volume relaxation set ENCUT >= 1.3*ENMAX to avoid Pulay stress. Always converge this for production.

ADDGRID.brief: Add additional support grid for augmentation charges

EDIFF.brief: Energy convergence criterion for electronic SC loop
EDIFF.notes: For phonons set <= 1E-6. For MD 1E-5 is often sufficient.

EDIFFG.brief: Convergence criterion for ionic relaxation. Negative = force criterion (recommended).
EDIFFG.notes: Negative value means force convergence in eV/Å (e.g., -0.01). Positive means energy difference in eV.

NELM.brief: Maximum number of electronic SC steps
NELM.notes: Increase to 200+ for difficult convergence cases.

NELMIN.brief: Minimum number of electronic SC steps

NSW.notes: 0 = single-point. For relaxation typically 100-500. For MD set to desired number of timesteps.

IBRION.notes: 2 (CG) is a robust default for relaxation. 1 (RMM-DIIS) faster when close to minimum. 0 for MD.

ISIF.brief: Controls which DOFs relax: 0-1=positions only, 2=positions+stress, 3=all(+volume+shape), 4=shape only, etc.
ISIF.notes: ISIF=3 for full cell relaxation. ISIF=2 for fixed cell. Set ENCUT high and PREC=Accurate when ISIF>=3.

POTIM.brief: Step width scaling for ionic relaxation, or timestep (fs) for MD
POTIM.notes: For relaxation ~0.1-1.0. For MD typically 1-2 fs.

NFREE.brief: Number of remembered steps in RMM-DIIS (IBRION=1), or displacements for finite diff (IBRION=5,6)

ISPIN.notes: Set to 2 for systems with magnetic elements (Fe, Co, Ni, Mn, Cr, etc.)

MAGMOM.notes: Must match number of ions. Use N*val syntax. E.g., '4*5.0 8*0.0' for 4 magnetic + 8 non-magnetic atoms.

LNONCOLLINEAR.notes: MAGMOM needs 3x entries (x,y,z per atom) when enabled.

LSORBIT.notes: Automatically sets LNONCOLLINEAR=.TRUE. Needed for heavy elements (5d, 6p).

ISMEAR.notes: Metals: 1 or 2 (MP). Semiconductors/insulators: 0 (Gaussian). Accurate DOS/total energy: -5 (tetrahedron). NEVER use -5 for MD or very few k-points.

SIGMA.notes: Metals with ISMEAR=1: 0.1-0.2. Semiconductors with ISMEAR=0: 0.01-0.05. Entropy term T*S should be < 1 meV/atom.

ICHARG.brief: How to construct initial charge density: 0=from WAVECAR, 1=from CHGCAR, 2=superposition of atoms, +10=keep fixed
ICHARG.notes: ICHARG=11 for non-SCF band structure calculation (keep charge from SCF fixed).

ISTART.brief: How to start: 0=from scratch, 1=continue from WAVECAR

LREAL.brief: Projection in real space (fast for large cells) or reciprocal space (accurate for small cells)
LREAL.notes: Use Auto for >20 atoms. Use .FALSE. for small cells and high-precision work.

NCORE.brief: Number of cores per orbital band
NCORE.notes: Set to sqrt(total_cores) as starting point. Must divide total cores evenly.

NPAR.brief: Number of bands treated in parallel (=total_cores/NCORE)

KPAR.brief: Number of k-points treated in parallel
KPAR.notes: Must divide total number of k-points. Use when many k-points available.

NSIM.brief: Number of bands optimized simultaneously in RMM-DIIS

METAGGA.notes: SCAN/R2SCAN are popular choices. Requires LASPH=.TRUE.

LHFCALC.notes: Must set ALGO=All or Damped. ALGO=VeryFast/Fast NOT supported.

IVDW.notes: DFT-D3(BJ) (IVDW=12) and MBD (IVDW=202) are popular choices.

LDAUL.brief: L quantum number for each species: -1=no U, 0=s, 1=p, 2=d, 3=f

LDAUU.brief: On-site Coulomb interaction U for each species

LDAUJ.brief: On-site exchange interaction J for each species
LDAUJ.notes: For LDAUTYPE=2, only U-J matters (Dudarev), so often set J=0.

LMAXMIX.brief: Max l for on-site density matrix PAW charge density mixing
LMAXMIX.notes: Set to 4 for d-electrons, 6 for f-electrons when using DFT+U.

LORBIT.brief: Write projected DOS and orbital-decomposed info
LORBIT.notes: 10/11 are most common. 11 includes lm-decomposition. Requires RWIGS for LORBIT<10.

NEDOS.brief: Number of grid points for DOS

NBANDS.default: auto (NELECT/2 + NIONS/2 for non-spin, more for spin)
NBANDS.notes: Increase for DOS, GW, optical properties. Must include enough empty bands.

NUPDOWN.brief: Fix spin moment (difference of up/down electrons). -1=not fixed.

LEPSILON.brief: Compute static dielectric tensor and Born effective charges via DFPT

CSHIFT.brief: Complex shift for Kramers-Kronig transformation in optics

DIPOL.brief: Center of cell for dipole corrections (fractional coordinates)

IDIPOL.brief: Direction of dipole correction: 1-3=along a1/a2/a3, 4=all directions

LDIPOL.brief: Enable dipole corrections to potential and forces

LASPH.brief: Include non-spherical PAW contributions to XC energy
LASPH.notes: REQUIRED for meta-GGA and strongly recommended for GGA+U, hybrid, GW.

LMAXMIX.brief: Max l-quantum number for on-site PAW density mixing

IMAGES.brief: Number of NEB images (for nudged elastic band calculations)
IMAGES.notes: Requires running VASP with corresponding number of MPI groups.

MDALGO.brief: MD algorithm: 0=standard NVE/NVT, 1=Andersen NVT, 2=Nosé-Hoover NVT, 3=Langevin NVT, 11=NpT
MDALGO.notes: 2 (Nosé-Hoover) and 3 (Langevin) are most common for NVT. 11 for NpT.

SMASS.brief: Controls Nosé mass in NVT MD. -3=NVE, -2=initial velocities scaling, -1=damped MD, >=0=Nosé-Hoover mass
SMASS.notes: Typical value 0-3 for Nosé-Hoover. Use MDALGO instead for new calculations.

LANGEVIN_GAMMA.brief: Friction coefficient per species for Langevin thermostat

ANDERSEN_PROB.brief: Collision probability per atom per timestep for Andersen thermostat

NBLOCK.brief: Write PCDAT and XDATCAR every NBLOCK ionic steps

ISYM.brief: Symmetry handling: -1=off, 0=off but use for k-mesh, 1=on(US-PP), 2=on(PAW), 3=off but symmetrize charge

LVTOT.brief: Write total local potential to LOCPOT

LVHAR.brief: Write Hartree potential only to LOCPOT (for work function)

IBAND.brief: Band indices for partial charge calculation

ENCUTGW.brief: Energy cutoff for response function in GW

NBANDSGW.brief: Number of bands for which GW self-energy is computed

NOMEGA.brief: Number of frequency points for GW/ACFDT

NPPSTR.brief: Number of k-points in Berry phase string

LCALCPOL.brief: Compute macroscopic polarization via Berry phase

LMAXMIX.brief: Max l for on-site density matrix
LMAXMIX.notes: 4 for d-electrons, 6 for f-electrons. Critical for DFT+U convergence.

ML_ISTART.brief: MLFF startup mode: 0=from scratch, 1=from ML_AB, 2=retrain, 3=prediction only

LATTICE_CONSTRAINTS.brief: Constrain lattice vectors during relaxation (T/F for a,b,c)

KSPACING.brief: Automatic k-mesh spacing (replaces KPOINTS file if set)
KSPACING.notes: Smaller = denser mesh = more accurate. Typical: 0.2-0.5 for metals, 0.3-0.5 for insulators.

LOCPROJ.brief: Local projectors for band unfolding, Wannier, etc.
